chunks: Three - Muhammad ibn Sinan from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Who will guarantee for me four [things] in return for four houses in Paradise? Spend [in charity] and do not fear poverty, treat people fairly with yourself, spread peace throughout the world, and abandon argumentation even if you are right.'
ai.seo_question: What are the four deeds guaranteed to bring four houses in Paradise according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kitab al-Zuhd* encapsulates the core of Shia ethical asceticism (Zuhd), linking material detachment with social harmony through the Prophet's promise of four houses in Paradise. It emphasizes that true piety involves not only personal restraint from argumentation but also active benevolence, such as spending without anxiety and disseminating peace, reflecting the Imams' teachings on balancing inner spirituality with outward social conduct.
